reason: ReDoS when picomatch compiles an attacker-supplied single-branch repeated extglob such as +(*a); affects every picomatch version (<=4.0.7, no patched release as of 2026-11-17). tavya never compiles a glob it did not write: no src/ file imports picomatch, micromatch, fast-glob, tinyglobby or vite. picomatch@2 is reached only through @daytona/sdk -> fast-glob -> micromatch, which the SDK loads only in Image.fromDockerfile/dockerfileCommands to expand a local Dockerfile's COPY sources; src/world/environment-build.ts builds Daytona snapshots with Image.base().runCommands() only. picomatch@4 is reached only through vitest/vite/tinyglobby/fdir (the test runner, and an optional peer of better-auth used only by its test-utils, which tavya does not import). Wiki: incidents/lessons, 2026-11-17.
